Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing port districts to provide limited consulting services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to port districts; adding a new section to chapter53.08 RCW; and adding new sections to chapter 43.131 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 53.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A port district may provide advisory consulting services forcompensation on matters within the scope of this title or Title 14 RCW.A port district may provide these services only to other publicagencies and governments, including foreign governments and governmentsponsored organizations. A port district providing consulting servicesmust create and maintain an open roster of Washington firms interestedin bidding on opportunities generated as a result. By enacting this legislation, the legislature intends to enhancethe ability of Washington port districts to facilitate economicopportunities for the benefit of Washington businesses. Nothing inthis section is intended to authorize direct competition by portdistricts with private business.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.131 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The authority to provide advisory consulting services under section1 of this act shall be terminated on July 1, 2008, as provided insection 3 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.131 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Section 1 of this act, as now existing or hereafter amended, isrepealed, effective July 1, 2009.
